stage: S1W existing-corpus weakly supervised CLAPSep domain adaptation

model.representation: bounded real magnitude mask (sigmoid) + mixture phase; STFT 1024/320 hann periodic, 32 kHz mono; phase=False (unchanged, per S1a audit)
model.trainable_scope: decoder_model only (HTSAT decoder + mask head), 149 trainable tensors
frozen: audio_branch pretrained HTSAT feature encoder including its LoRA adapters (eval mode, no_grad feature extraction)
decoder spec_norm BatchNorm running state (eval mode = normalization state frozen)

query_policy.condition: FIXED S1E primary: audio query Q1 (R3 single visually-confirmed contact event), zero negative embedding
query_policy.sweep: none; frozen from S1E prior work; no prompt tuned against sealed or any test data

optimization.amp: bfloat16 autocast around decoder+loss; STFT/ISTFT float paths as dispatched by torch
optimization.pause_rule: if no meaningful DEV learning by ~1000 updates, pause and diagnose

loss.mrstft_log_note: log magnitude is required: linear ratio normalization explodes on near-silent hard-negative targets (|s| rms ~0.01 at -30 dB TNR) and derails optimization; found in the first launch, fixed before any DEV/eval use
loss.target_only: same recon terms vs s_proxy (identity F(s)~s)

mixture_distribution.bookkeeping: y = guard*(s + gain*n); requested and measured TNR, gains, placements and files stored per example (exact)

checkpoint_selection.rule: DEV-only; maximize composite = (zero_shot preservation_sum / current preservation_sum) + (leakage_reduction_db/10); components always reported; guardrail: weak-stratum DEV recon_l1 must not exceed zero-shot by >10%

budget.replication: one replication seed only if primary run clearly stable and promising
